title: Chapter 1062
text:
Boom!

The silver fist collided with the dark brown fist, and a shockwave spread out. Gorután was once again sent flying by Han Xiao's Infinite Charge.

Han Xiao did not use the Mechanical Deity. Instead, he kept fighting in close combat with his original body. When the cooldown of (Endless Charge) was over, he would move to the side and farm steps, accumulating the power of his Iron Head ability.

Even if Gorután wanted to stop him, he would be stopped by the huge Mech Legion.

Without the restriction of the Space Stabilizing Anchor, Han Xiao's troops kept pouring out of the secondary dimensional army box and the Dimension Factory. At this time, the Mech Legion was mainly responsible for the battle. Under the leadership of the Apostle Weapons and the Mysterious Energy Host, they tried their best to contain and deal damage to the enemy.

The peak Beyond Grade A Pugilist had amazing individual combat strength. Gorután was not surrounded, but he was still having a hard time being surrounded by the Mech Legion. Not to mention, there was also a guy beside him who would hit him from time to time.

His current situation was like he was in some sort of unbeatable game, where the difficulty level was high and he was alone in a sea of enemies. The small soldiers had long health bars, and their damage was not low either. The Apostle Weapons were like small generals in the army, and there was even Han Xiao, who was like a sh * t stirrer in the environment. Therefore, although Gorutan's individual combat strength was much higher than the mechanical army, he could not play unbeatable at will and could only be cautious.

In the encirclement of cannon fire, wherever Gorután went, dark brown flames would scatter, and mechanical soldiers would be blown away. He fought left and right while urging his cells to proliferate and heal the new wounds that were constantly being created.

Feeling the burning pain of his torn tendons healing, Gorután was very frustrated.

When a Pugilist fought a Mechanic, charging at the enemy was the best strategy, but he was annoyed whenever he saw Han Xiao's Main Body near him. (Infinite Charge) was really making him uncomfortable, and he could not control the rhythm of the battle.

Now, whenever he saw Han Xiao moving around, Gorután could not help but roar in his mind.

Don't come over!

On the other side, although Han Xiao had a slight advantage, he was not very optimistic.

Although Pugilists did not have any fancy means, and their combat style was very pure, when they reached the peak of Beyond Grade A, this kind of purity would result in a transformation. It was as if they had been tempered thousands of times, finally making themselves indestructible.

"My tankiness is second to none among Mechanics, mainly because of my strong recovery ability. However, the recovery ability of a peak Beyond Grade A Pugilist is not to be underestimated, and his HP is even higher than mine."

Pugilists had a lot of talents that increased their Endurance, and their own class also had special bonuses. At the pinnacle Beyond Grade A level, no class could compare to Pugilists in terms of HP. Not even Ol 'Amos was an exception. Moreover, pinnacle Pugilists might not necessarily not have a bug-level HP recovery ability similar to his own. They were the real heavy tank tanks, and the so-called tanky and capable of dealing damage referred to him.

Before this, Sierron was constantly fighting and running, and he was dragged down by his teammates. This was the first time Han Xiao was fighting a peak Pugilist who was going all out. Even if he was currently in an explosive state, it was impossible for him to easily deal with Gorután like he did with a normal Beyond Grade A Pugilist.

The two of them fought endlessly, and the scene was intense. Not far away, Beast Ancestor's fleet was hesitating.

"Father is fighting. Should we help?"

In the bridge of the command ship, the eyes of many crew members were focused on one of the Calamity Grade officers.

This person was one of Gorután's direct descendants, and he was the commander of this fleet. His name was Byram.

"That's a battle between Beyond Grade As. It's not suitable for us to interfere." Byram hesitated.

"Black Star is here for revenge, not a duel. Father is in a tough battle, and it's not suitable for us to watch him get beaten up," another Calamity Grade officer said.

"But with just us, we won't be of much use in such a battlefield. Just the shockwaves from their battle will cause us to suffer losses." Byram frowned.

"At the very least, we are also combat forces. If we can help a little, it will be a little bit. Lord Father may need us."

Byram turned to look at him, and as expected, he saw fanaticism in the other party's eyes.

The way Gorután raised his descendants was naturally not something that all of his descendants agreed with, and the faction was not united. Although everyone's father was Gorutan, many of their brothers and sisters had different mothers. Their relationship with each other was different, causing the internal factions to be intricate and complicated, with undercurrents surging.

Generally speaking, they could be divided into three types of people. Byram was a neutral person and only followed his duties. Although he called his father, he did not have any sense of belonging to the faction. An officer who urged him to participate in the battle belonged to the loyal faction.

Just as Byram was thinking about how to deal with the situation, a huge fleet approached from afar. The outer armor was painted with the Beast Ancestor's symbol. This was the army that had rushed over from the stronghold to support Beast Ancestor after not receiving a response for a long time.

"They're finally here." Byram's spirits were lifted when he saw this.

The two sides quickly converged, and many officers met.

Since the reinforcements were already here, there was no point in continuing to watch the show. Byram shook his head and changed his words.

"With our current strength, we are qualified to participate in this battle. We don't need to kill many mechanical soldiers. As long as we can delay a portion of them, we will be able to reduce the pressure on Father. Let's do it."

The fleet spread out and gradually approached the battlefield.

Han Xiao noticed this, turned around, and frowned.

In the exploration era, it was not uncommon for Beyond Grade As to be killed by fleets. Even if Beyond Grade As had great strength, they could not treat large fleets as air. If Beast Ancestor's troops were to participate in the battle, it would indeed cause some trouble.

Even if he was a Virtual Mechanic, he would have to gradually invade the enemy. This way, he would have to divert his attention. At the same time, the Mech Legion would also have to divert a portion of their forces to face the fleet, which would reduce the pressure on Gorután. If it was an ordinary opponent, it would not matter. However, Gorután was an opponent of the same level, so any details would be magnified.

Most of the fleets in the Black Star stronghold were cleaning up the battlefield. When Han Xiao set off to find Gorután, he had also ordered a portion of the fleets to come over and provide support. However, Yin Ying was too fast and left most of the fleets behind. His own fleet was still halfway there.

Suddenly, a magical wave bloomed.

Buzz!

Just as Beast Ancestor's army was about to intervene, a gigantic teleportation gate suddenly appeared in the middle of the battlefield, spitting out several battleships bearing the empire's insignia and blocking Beast Ancestor's army.

"The dynasty's people are finally here." Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Although the dynasty did not make it in time to rescue Hella, it was still useful now. It was better to be late than never. At the very least, they could pretend to be police officers to clean up the mess.

Very soon, all the dynasty's reinforcements arrived on the battlefield. Ravenlaude was the last to fly out of the portal. He waved his staff and deactivated this large-scale teleportation spell.

Seeing the situation, Kant smiled.

"It seems like we came at the right time."

This accident was a surprise for Han Xiao, but it was a shock for Beast Ancestor's subordinates.

"Stop immediately!"

A few Beyond Grade A energy sources appeared on the spaceship's radar. Byram was shocked and quickly ordered the fleet to stop, not daring to get any closer. He faced the dynasty's troops from afar and became hesitant again.

Kant and the others ignored Beast Ancestor's fleet and turned to look at the battle. Seeing Han Xiao's strength, they could not help but be amazed.

"As expected of Black Star in his explosive form. His strength is obviously one level higher than his normal form." Kohler sighed. "Unfortunately, the price for this power is a bit high."

Kant contacted Han Xiao, smiled, and asked, "How is it?

Do you need help? "

"Just help me hold the line. Don't let him escape," Han Xiao replied very quickly.

This was a personal grudge, and it was also a rare opportunity to establish his authority. Han Xiao planned to deal with Gorután alone. The dynasty's allies were here, so they could guard the area and prevent others from interfering. They could create an undisturbed one-on-one situation and prevent Gorután from escaping.

"Since you don't need us to do anything, we'll respect your wishes."

Kant did not have any objections. According to Han Xiao's request, he ordered the troops to spread out and form an encirclement.

Seeing himself surrounded by strong enemies, Gorután's face darkened. He knew there was no way out.

Regret … a little.

However, he did not dwell on it. Since he had already done it, he would not turn back and think about it.

At this point, there was no point in saying anything. Gorután only silently increased the strength of his attacks, erupting with all his strength without holding back.

"Let me see what you're capable of, Black Star!"

At the same time, Byram's fleet did not dare attack the dynasty's troops. They could only watch as the dynasty set up a defense line right under their noses. They could only watch as their boss was beaten up and surrounded by the enemy.

Seeing the dynasty's formation, many officers, including Byram, felt a strong sense of uneasiness in their hearts. They also had a bad feeling that their backer was about to collapse.

"Father has nowhere to run. The dynasty is determined to capture him."

"We can't watch father get captured by the dynasty!"

"How can we help? There are several dynasty Beyond Grade As on the other side. We'll only be sending ourselves to our deaths if we help. "

"Is there a way to solve this situation? Who can help? Can the protectors of the Galactic Black Market help? "

"With such a big thing happening, they can't even hide. How can they interfere?"

As a protector of the Galactic Black Market, Gorután had his own backer. At this moment, he was alone. At this juncture, there would naturally not be any Beyond Grade A allies from the three Universal Civilizations to help him.

At this moment, everyone, including Byram, had a fearful thought.

"It's over. The world is going to change …"

Thinking of this possibility, some officers and crew members secretly had other thoughts.

Apart from the loyal and neutral factions, the last faction in the Beast Ancestor's faction was the rebels. Some of the Beast Ancestor's descendants hated their own identity and secretly hated Gorután, their 'father'. They were descendants in name, but they were actually slaves. These people had always pretended to be obedient and followed the orders of the Beast Ancestor, but they actually wanted to kill him.

Now that they saw Gorután being retaliated against by a strong enemy, this group of rebels felt extremely happy, and the ambition in their hearts continued to grow.

…

In a certain remote location in the Flickering World, a teleportation gate appeared out of nowhere and spat out Traveler.

"I'm finally out." Traveler heaved a sigh of relief. He had quite a few injuries on his body, and he looked quite haggard.

He had flown a long distance before finally escaping the range of the Black Star fleet's spacetime stabilizing anchor. Along the way, he had been chased by Ames and Hella and suffered a lot of injuries. Fortunately, he had used teleportation to escape from the Black Star's territory.

Traveler took out his communicator and contacted the person in charge of the Supercluster Alliance.

"Things have gone awry. Hila has mysteriously returned to the Black Star Palace. My mission has failed."

"We've already expected this. Black Star ignited his potential and erupted with shocking strength. Not only did he force the Radiance and Ethereal troops to retreat, he even captured a few Beyond Grade As as captives. This news hasn't spread to the outside world yet. Currently, only the advanced organizations know the details. Your Excellency Traveler, it's fine as long as you're fine."

"I see …" Traveler shook his head. After deactivating the Evil Convergence, his evil aura disappeared, and he returned to his normal appearance. "I've offended the Black Star Corps this time, so I'm going to travel in the secondary dimensions to avoid the limelight. I probably won't appear in the main universe for a long time, so don't ask me to do anything during this time."

"Understood. Don't worry and go take refuge. Since we didn't provoke another conflict between the three Universal Civilizations, we won't be involved in this kind of thing for the time being. Just focus on developing."

"Hmm, Black Star still doesn't know my identity. At most, he'll be dissatisfied with me, but he won't blame you. As long as I disappear, he'll stop … By the way, Sorokin thinks I was hired, but he might have noticed something. This person is not reliable, so be careful."

"Understood."

Traveler gave some instructions before hanging up. He sighed in his heart.

Who knew how long it would take for him to come back after hiding in the secondary dimensions this time …

Silently taking one last look at this universe, Traveler cast a spell, stepped into the secondary dimensions, and disappeared without a trace.

…

Time flew by.

The two of them fought for a long time, and the situation finally came to an end under the watchful eyes of everyone.

A large number of mechanical troops were destroyed, and their quality dropped by several grades. Three Apostle Weapons were completely destroyed, four Apostle Weapons were temporarily paralyzed, the Mechanical Deity disintegrated once, and his mount Yin Ying's health dropped below the danger level … Han Xiao paid a huge price to make Gorután, who was fighting with all his strength, run out of fuel.

Although peak Pugilists recovered their energy quickly, they did not have nearly unlimited energy like Kasuyi.

As far as the eye could see, the battlefield was filled with mechanical wreckage, and the Dimension Factory was tirelessly recycling parts.

In the center of the battlefield, Gorutan's face was filled with exhaustion. His wounds were slowly healing, and hot blood was still spurting out. He was no longer recovering as quickly as he had been at the start.

"You've lost. Do you have anything to say?"

Han Xiao faced him, opened the mechanical suit's helmet, and stared at the other party.

Although it was because of the buff, this was still the first time he had defeated a peak Beyond Grade A in a head-on battle.

"Cough cough … a loss is a loss. There's nothing to say." Gorután grinned, revealing his blood-stained teeth. "What, do you think I'll beg for mercy?"

"There's always a price to pay for scheming against others. Since you provoked others, you should have thought of the consequences."

"Humph, don't talk nonsense with me. I can afford to play. At least I made you burn your potential, and the upper limit of your growth will forever be lowered."

Han Xiao shook his head and laughed in his heart.

Even if he explained, the other party probably would not believe him. Plus, he would not explain it to outsiders.

He paused, changed the topic, and slowly said, "You provoked me back then.

If you had endured a little loss, it wouldn't have evolved into today's situation. Compared to the lifespan you lost, you lost more things now. "

"If I had endured it, I wouldn't be me," Gorután said with a deep voice. "If I can't do whatever I want, what's the point of having great strength?"

Some people chased after strength itself, while others chased after the added value of strength. Every Beyond Grade A was the former, and only after the conditions were met did they gradually become the latter.

Not only Beyond Grade A, the entire Super class was like this.

"No matter what, I'll gladly accept your body." Han Xiao raised his hand and pressed on Gorután's chest.

"Humph, take it. If you're so capable, don't ever let me find a chance to turn the tables."

Gorután stood proudly without any fear.

Hysteria was the style of a small character, and he was already mentally prepared. Even if he had lost, he still maintained his last bit of composure. Regardless of whether he won or lost, he would accept it calmly.

The next moment, his stubborn expression froze, and his spurting blood froze.

Beast Ancestor, Gorután, sealed in the Spacetime Amber!
